{{Hatnote|For the card, see [[Limited Resources]].}}
'''Limited Resources Format''' ('''LR''') is a Players Committee constructed format. All the Decipher cards are included, the most abusive cards are removed, and some cards from virtual sets are included to help certain decks.<ref name="pc-lr" /> It was developed by [[Steve Skilton]] (forum handle '''stevetotheizz0''') in 2020 and went live on [[GEMP]] in December 2020.<ref name="pc-debut" /><ref name="t76030" /> The PC page gives the card list as Limited Resources Format Version 1.0 (January 15, 2021).<ref name="pc-lr" />

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Developed by:''' [[Steve Skilton]] (stevetotheizz0), who thanked "Matt H-T" for helping come up with it<ref name="t76030" />
* '''Card pool:''' almost only Decipher cards, with a ban list and a short list of virtual cards<ref name="pc-debut" /><ref name="pc-lr" />
* '''GEMP:''' ''Limited Resources'' (<code>limited_resources</code>), live since 18 December 2020<ref name="t76030" /><ref name="gemp" />

On [[GEMP]] it is named '''Limited Resources''' (code <code>limited_resources</code>). The definition uses Decipher set ids 1&ndash;13, premium ids 101&ndash;112 and Virtual Set ids 200&ndash;203, 205&ndash;207 and 210, and bans 726 card printings. It links to the PC page and is marked as not a game hall format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" />

== History ==
=== Proposal (July 2020) ===
On 31 July 2020 stevetotheizz0 proposed the format in the GEMP (Online Play) board of the Players Committee forum.<ref name="t76030" /> He argued that some Decipher cards set the power curve that Open is always stuck with, naming Wesa/WMAOP, Ref III Leia, maintenance cards and even EPPs.<ref name="t76030" /> His list was "basically almost all non-ep1 cards", minus cards thought too strong or "uncorrected mistakes in the game". It kept helpers such as ROPS and You May Start Your Landing.<ref name="t76030" /> He suggested it could replace the classic format and hoped to change the ban list every six months.<ref name="t76030" /> He thanked the PC and Gemp team, and "Matt H-T for helping come up with this format".<ref name="t76030" />

=== Launch on GEMP (December 2020) ===
On 24 November 2020 he wrote that GEMP is open source and the format looked very easy to code. Batmouse ([[Anthony Howard]]) replied that he would run leagues for it once it was in.<ref name="t76030" /> On 18 December 2020 he posted that the format was live on Gemp and in the deckbuilder. A Gemp league was set up to start after Christmas.<ref name="t76030" /><ref name="t76030-p2" />

The Players Committee announced the format on 19 December 2020. It said Steve Skilton developed it "earlier in 2020" and linked his forum post.<ref name="pc-debut" /> It summed up LR as almost only Decipher cards, with a handful of virtual cards and toned-down power. Popular shields are played only through the Decipher Starting Effects, and Negative Play Experience cards are banned.<ref name="pc-debut" /> It named three target groups: new and returning players (NARP), players who want an "unsolved meta", and players who find Open too fast or too strong.<ref name="pc-debut" /> The Gemp League Administrator, [[Anthony Howard]], set up an LR League with Gemp virtual prizes.<ref name="pc-debut" />

=== Beta period and the January 2021 update ===
On 30 December 2020 stevetotheizz0 opened a feedback thread. He called the release a "Beta" period and planned an update in one to three months.<ref name="t76959" /> He asked whether to then change about 20 cards every six months.<ref name="t76959" />

The update was posted on 19 January 2021 under the heading "UPDATE 1/15". It followed about a month of beta play and changed 38 cards: 9 banned and 29 added.<ref name="t76030-p2" /><ref name="t76030" /> Mobilization Points and Staging Areas were removed, and Establish Control (V) and Rebellions Are Built On Hope (V) were added.<ref name="t76030-p2" /> Enhanced Premiere Luke and Vader were added after players asked for EPPs. Bad Feeling Have I, Goo Nee Tay, Lost In The Wilderness, Always Thinking With Your Stomach and Honor Of The Jedi were banned.<ref name="t76030-p2" /><ref name="t76030" /> Nine of the added cards came from Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck, for Agents In The Court and My Kind Of Scum.<ref name="t76030-p2" /> The PC page's Version 1.0 list also carries an "Added 1/15" mark.<ref name="pc-lr" />

=== Later changes ===
In February 2021 the Team Albany league played the format.<ref name="t76030-p2" /> On 28 February 2021 stevetotheizz0 wrote that he was watching Responsibility Of Command and the remaining EPPs, and that Grimtaash might return.<ref name="t76030-p3" /> On 31 August 2021 he wrote that the format was still an option on Gemp and that "another round of changes" had been added.<ref name="t76030-p3" /> On 7 September 2021 Echo Base Trooper fixed the GEMP list, which had shown General Veers (V) in place of Veers (V).<ref name="t76030-p3" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

== Card list ==
The PC page lists, set by set, which cards are legal and which are banned. For example, [[Theed Palace]] is banned, and most virtual cards are banned except a short list of named ones.<ref name="pc-lr" />

== Discrepancies ==
* '''Creator's name.''' The PC format page says Limited Resources "was originally developed by Steve Izzo". That name links to forum thread t=76030.<ref name="pc-lr" /> The thread's author posts as stevetotheizz0 and links his decklist archive at stephenskilton.com.<ref name="t76030" /> The PC's December 2020 news post names the developer as Steve Skilton and links the same thread.<ref name="pc-debut" /> "Steve Izzo" matches the handle stevetotheizz0, not a second designer.
* '''Date of the first update.''' The PC page dates Version 1.0 to January 15, 2021, and the forum post is headed "UPDATE 1/15".<ref name="pc-lr" /><ref name="t76030-p2" /> The same update was posted on 19 January 2021, and its change summary is headed "1/18 Change Summary".<ref name="t76030-p2" />
